notes.title: Summer update
notes.content: [h3]Enjoy the summer with new Cuby designs like the Hawaiian, Sun Cuby, Ice Cube, and Beach.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048668/b839f8a82acac92102bf44dbd46b38ae1e93c318.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]This update also includes quality improvements:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Cuby[/b][/p][list][*][p]Endless mode. Let's bounce, endlessly. Cuby won't stop till your break is done. Viewers can continuously post emotes. Good for a long I'm Only Sleeping session. [/p][/*][*][p]During normal play, viewers can spam multiple emotes to fill the screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Victory Dance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Typing !wave will now respond with a chat message with the number of dancers still in play.[/p][/*][*][p]Viewers typing !join and an emote now still enter the game. [/p][/*][*][p]Solved a bug where the recent winner didn't show[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resolved a problem where the chatbot did not always appear in chat. [/p][/*][*][p]Chat commands are not case sensitive.[/p][/*][*][p]Some minor text adjustments [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🎄🎅 Christmas update 🎅🎄
notes.content: Enjoy your breaks during Christmas, or before, while Cuby switches between different Christmas designs on each bounce! You can activate the theme in the settings page.

notes.title: Updates notes for 17 October
notes.content: You can now adjust the SFX and Music for Stream Invaders and Victory Dance independently.

notes.title: Get in the Spooktober mood with our Halloween update
notes.content: Take a break during a horror game, but stay within the theme. Cuby, the bouncing cube will switch between different Halloween designs on each bounce! You can activate the theme in the settings page.

notes.title: Multilingual support
notes.content:
We've added support for the following languages:
- French
- German
- Korean
- Spanish
- Brazilian Portuguese 

If you want to help us improve the translations, contact us via Discord.

notes.title: Update notes for august 6
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the connection with the Twitch chat would get lost and not recover, which prevented chat messages to come through.

notes.title: Victory dance fix
notes.content: We fixed a problem where creators couldn't adjust the participation ratio in Victory Dance
